schemas.name: agent.yaml
schemas.description: Saved agent definition: runtime, environment, content, role and native permissions. Generated from the serde model; save-time semantic validation still applies.

fields.name: allowWake
fields.description:
A routine may wake a running session of this
agent even while it skips permission checks (bypass or unattended).
Off by default; it means nothing for an agent that keeps its checks.

fields.name: args
fields.description: Appended to the runtime's argv; never a raw command line.

fields.name: avatar
fields.description:
The face its sessions wear when a launch names none: `pack:id`, or a
colour or emoji. Display only.

fields.name: context
fields.description:
The bulk content sets a workspace gets for this agent.
Absent means the runtime's default, resolved at launch and never
written back ([`super::context::default_context`]); `[]` means none.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description:
The local user id that created it. Attribution only, never a permission:
any teammate may edit a team agent.

fields.name: env
fields.description:
Environment variables every launch sets on the runtime's process, by
name. CodeSense's own launch variables are always CodeSense's, and any
other variable CodeSense sets for the launch wins over one here of the
same name. Every value is a string. Anyone who can read the agent sees
them: not for secrets.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Immutable once created.

fields.name: launch
fields.description: How a launch runs the agent unless the launcher or routine overrides it.

fields.name: mcp
fields.description:
Which MCP servers the agent can reach, by `.mcp.json` server key. The
CodeSense bridge is always present and never listed.

fields.name: mcp.bridge_tools
resumeAfterRestart
fields.description:
After a terminal server update ends its session, the
session is relaunched as this same Agent, in its workspace and tab,
with a resume brief CodeSense builds from what it knows (never a CLI
session id). Off by default.

fields.name: startup
fields.description:
Ordered content-relative paths, stored normalized by every save. Kept as
written on read so one bad hand edit is a typed validation error, not
an unreadable definition.

schemas.example:
id: reviewer
name: Reviewer
runtime: codex
role: reviewer
env:
  CHANNEL: review
context:
  - path: docs
revision: 1

schemas.name: org.yml
schemas.description: Organization config. One per context repo at its root. Declares the org slug, display name, tag schema, and credential bindings.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-normalized org identifier. Must match the directory name.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Human-readable organization name.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Organization creation timestamp. Auto-set on first write.

fields.name: remote_url
fields.description: Git remote URL (e.g. GitHub SSH origin).

fields.name: config_flags.workspace_root_dir
fields.description: Alternative location for managed source clones. Defaults to ~/.codesense/sources/.

fields.name: tag_schema
fields.description: Team-defined tag registry. Empty dict = unopinionated default.

fields.name: credential_ref
fields.description: Bound context-repo connection (provider, account id).

fields.name: people
fields.description: Organization members.

schemas.example:
slug: acme
display_name: Acme Inc.
remote_url: git@github.com:acme/context.git
tag_schema:
  categories:
    - id: priority
      label: Priority
      tags:
        - id: p0
          label: Critical
          color: red
        - id: p1
          label: High
people: []

schemas.name: role config YAML
schemas.description: Durable role queue display settings and optional default handler. Save through role_save; this does not launch a handler or change queue registrations.
schemas.example:
id: reviewer
name: Review
icon: builtin-chess:knight
defaultHandler: acme/dev/reviewer

schemas.name: routine.yml
schemas.description: An agent task or argv command, run manually, on a schedule, on an event or after another routine. Generated from RoutineDef; save-time validation checks valid combinations.

fields.name: agent
fields.description:
The agent that runs the task; see [`AgentRef`]. A routine stored under
its agent (`config/agents/<agent>/routines/<id>/`) does not write it: the
path names the agent and every read fills it in (`layout`). Only a
legacy `config/routines/<id>/` file or an `_unassigned` one carries it.

fields.name: archived_with_agent
fields.description:
Archived because its agent was archived: restoring the agent offers to
restore exactly these (`lifecycle`).

fields.name: arm_epoch
fields.description:
Bumped on every move of the routine between a desktop and a
machine. A machine refuses an arm or disarm older than the epoch it
holds, so a stale definition can never re-arm it there.

fields.name: armed_host
fields.description:
The local host id of the one Mac that arms this routine, so it fires
once however many machines have it. Placement, not permission: anyone
may move it. Unset only in a definition written outside CodeSense; see
`host::is_armed_here`.

fields.name: armed_machine
fields.description:
The team-shared id of the machine whose session server arms this
routine: it fires there on the machine's own clock, with or
without a desktop. `armed_host` then names the Mac that manages the
arm (pushes it, and records its runs); no Mac fires it itself. Old
clients carry it as an unknown key.

fields.name: handover_from
fields.description:
The machine this routine moved off and the epoch of that
move, until that machine acknowledged it stopped firing it. No Mac
fires the routine meanwhile (it may still fire there), whichever Mac
reads this; the Mac that manages it clears it once acknowledged.

fields.name: migrated
fields.description: Where a migrated routine came from (`migrate`).

fields.name: migrated.from
fields.description:
The legacy dir relative to the space's `config/`: `routines/<id>`.
The legacy content last brought forward (the 3-way merge base for an
older client's edits) is kept beside the routine, in
`migrate::BASE_FILE`, so mirroring it never rewrites this file.

fields.name: migrated.note
fields.description: Shown with the routine: why it was renamed on the way (an id clash).

fields.name: migrated.revision
fields.description:
The revision the move wrote: the editor says why the routine
starts a new session only until a later revision is saved.

fields.name: mode
fields.description:
What a fire does: `fresh` starts a new instance of the agent, `wake`
delivers the task into a live one (starting one only when
none is running). Blank when the author picked none: the default is worked out
at fire time (`service::effective_mode`); migration writes `fresh`.
Kept as a string so an unknown value is a
typed [`ValidationError`]; see [`RoutineDef::mode`].

fields.name: owner
fields.description:
The principal who created this routine, for display and attribution.
It grants nothing: anyone who can see a routine can change it.

fields.name: policy.max_runtime
fields.description:
Required. `30m` / `2h`, between one minute and a day. Optional on the wire
only so a missing value is a typed validation error.

fields.name: policy.max_wakes
fields.description:
Optional, set by the routine's author (usually an
agent): how many deliveries its wakes may make in all. Reached, the
routine pauses itself with one inbox note; resuming starts a new count.

fields.name: policy.max_wakes_per_day
fields.description:
Deliveries in any rolling 24 h. Over it a fire is
`undelivered(limit_reached)`; it resumes on its own.

fields.name: policy.min_gap
fields.description:
The least time between two wakes of this routine, into any session (`30m`,
`2h`, `1d`; at most `7d`), for wakes that start heavy work. A fire
inside it is coalesced or skipped per `overlap`.

fields.name: result_schema
fields.description: Optional bounded inline JSON Schema for a private dashboard snapshot.

fields.name: runs_on
fields.description:
How a team routine runs: `one_mac` (the default, also when empty) runs
it once for the team on the `armed_host` Mac; `each_mac` runs it on
every Mac whose user turned it on there, each with its own runs. Kept
as a string so an unknown value is a typed [`ValidationError`]; see
[`RoutineDef::runs_on`].

fields.name: triggers
fields.description: Empty means manual-only.

fields.name: triggers[]
fields.description:
One trigger. On the wire it is a single-key map: `- schedule: {…}` or
`- event: {…}`.

fields.name: triggers[].schedule
fields.description:
A wall-clock schedule: a 5-field cron in an IANA zone (see
[`super::schedule`]). A missing `tz` is filled with this machine's zone at
save and persisted, so it never changes with where the app later runs.

fields.name: triggers[].event
fields.description:
An event trigger: `agent_done` (an agent finished), `inbox_idle` (an agent sits
idle at its prompt with unread inbox mail) or `role_pending` (a message is queued
for a role inbox in reach of the routine).

fields.name: triggers[].event.from_agent
fields.description:
`agent_done` only: only an agent this names finishing fires it; read like
[`RoutineDef::agent`].

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.list
fields.description: An authoring hint for list wording; matching always uses the query engine.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.previous.key
fields.description:
Any frontmatter key, or a built-in field (`path`, `relPath`, `fileName`,
`id`, `org`, `team`, `layer`, `kind`, `mtime`, `title`, `parentEpic`).
Matching ignores case, `-`/`_` and camelCase vs snake_case.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.previous.op
fields.description: A filter operator.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.previous.value
fields.description:
The operand for `eq`/`in`/`not`/`contains`/`prefix`. `"@me"` stands for the
signed-in user.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection
fields.description: The query. See the module docs for an example.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.cursor
fields.description: The `nextCursor` of a previous page.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.filters[]
fields.description: One filter clause. Clauses on the same key OR together; different keys AND.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.filters[].key
fields.description:
Any frontmatter key, or a built-in field (`path`, `relPath`, `fileName`,
`id`, `org`, `team`, `layer`, `kind`, `mtime`, `title`, `parentEpic`).
Matching ignores case, `-`/`_` and camelCase vs snake_case.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.filters[].op
fields.description: A filter operator.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.filters[].value
fields.description:
The operand for `eq`/`in`/`not`/`contains`/`prefix`. `"@me"` stands for the
signed-in user.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.groupBy
fields.description: Count matches per value of this key (every item of a list counts).

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.match
fields.description:
Shorthand: `{ "status": ["todo", "review"], "team": "default" }` — a
scalar is `eq`, an array is `in`.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.relationships.backlinkedBy
fields.description: This lists the file in its `supporting_docs`.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.relationships.dependedOnBy
fields.description: This depends on the file (the file is a dependency of it).

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.relationships.dependsOn
fields.description: The file `depends_on` this.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.relationships.hasSupportingDoc
fields.description: The file lists this in `supporting_docs`.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.relationships.parentEpic
fields.description: The file's parent epic (`parent_epic`/`epic` frontmatter, or a folder on its path).

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.select
fields.description:
Frontmatter keys to return (plus the built-in row fields). Include
`"relationships"` to also get relationship refs. Omitted: everything.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.sort
fields.description: Sort keys, applied in order; ties fall back to path. Default: path.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.sort[]
fields.description:
One sort key: `"status"`, `"-mtime"` (descending), or the object form.
`order` ranks values explicitly (e.g. a team's own status order); values
not listed sort after the listed ones. It also orders `groupBy` buckets
when the group key is sorted on.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.sort[].dir
fields.description: Sort direction.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.sort[].missing
fields.description: Where files without a value for the sort key go. Default: last.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.text
fields.description: Token-aware title, heading and body match (bounded scan).

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where
fields.description: Where to look. Every dimension narrows; omitted means unconstrained.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.kinds[]
fields.description:
What a file is, by the existing classification rules (frontmatter `type`,
file extension, location).

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.layers[]
fields.description: Which layer of the context footprint a file lives in.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.orgs
fields.description: Orgs to search. Default: every synced org. All-orgs content matches any org.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.pathGlob
fields.description: A glob over the path relative to the content root (e.g. `**/DEMO-*.md`).

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.pathPrefix
fields.description: An absolute path prefix, or a prefix of the path relative to the content root.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.sameOrgAs
fields.description:
Limit to the org of the content root this absolute path (a file or a
folder) sits under — a UI default, e.g. a `csquery` block searching its
own org. Fails closed: a path under no org's root (all-orgs content, or
outside the footprint) leaves only all-orgs content.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.sameRootAs
fields.description:
Limit to the one content root (a team's context repo, a private space, or
all-orgs content) this absolute path sits under — e.g. a team board
listing its own team's stories. Nothing matches when the path is under no root.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.selection.where.teams
fields.description: Team names. Private and all-orgs files have no team, so naming teams excludes them.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.target
fields.description: One filter clause. Clauses on the same key OR together; different keys AND.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.target.key
fields.description:
Any frontmatter key, or a built-in field (`path`, `relPath`, `fileName`,
`id`, `org`, `team`, `layer`, `kind`, `mtime`, `title`, `parentEpic`).
Matching ignores case, `-`/`_` and camelCase vs snake_case.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.target.op
fields.description: A filter operator.

fields.name: triggers[].event.metadata.target.value
fields.description:
The operand for `eq`/`in`/`not`/`contains`/`prefix`. `"@me"` stands for the
signed-in user.

fields.name: triggers[].event.role
fields.description: `role_pending` only: watch this queue; omit to watch every queue in reach.

fields.name: variables.*
fields.description:
A declared task variable. `default` is required when any trigger is a
schedule, because nobody is there to supply a value.

fields.name: where
fields.description: Where the run happens. `kind` is `team_workspace` or `repo:<owner>/<repo>`.

fields.name: where.machine
fields.description:
Which machine runs it: `local`, `any` or a team-shared machine id;
absent means local.

schemas.example:
id: morning-review
name: Morning review
owner: codesense
mode: fresh
task: Review stories and report the result.
where:
  kind: team_workspace
triggers:
  - schedule:
      cron: '0 9 * * 1-5'
      tz: UTC
policy:
  max_runtime: 5m
revision: 1

schemas.name: teams.yml
schemas.description: Team roster for an org. Array of team objects; each team may declare a parent for context inheritance.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unique team name per org.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Directory name under teams/. Kebab-case.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: Human-readable label.

fields.name: remote
fields.description: Git remote key, e.g. "origin" or "upstream".

fields.name: remote_url
fields.description: Git clone URL.

fields.name: parent_team
fields.description: Single-parent chain for inheritance. No cycles, max depth 64.

fields.name: landing_page
fields.description: The team's starter page, relative to its content folder (no `..`, no hidden file or folder), opened whenever the team has nothing open. Set it from a file's menu (Set as team starter page), Settings → Workspace, or the set_team_starter_page MCP tool. Unset: README.md, README.html or index.html there, else nothing.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Team description.

fields.name: is_archived
fields.description: Archived teams don't appear in the switcher.

fields.name: settings
fields.description: Team-level overrides.

schemas.example:
- name: Backend
  slug: backend
  display_name: Backend Team
  remote: origin
  remote_url: git@github.com:acme/api.git
  description: Core backend services
  parent_team: null
  is_archived: false

- name: Auth
  slug: auth
  display_name: Auth Subsystem
  remote: origin
  parent_team: Backend

schemas.name: worktree.yaml
schemas.description: Runtime state for a context-repo worktree. Tracks sync status and mtime cache for warm starts. Managed by the sync engine; rarely hand-edited.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Worktree identifier, typically team/repo.

fields.name: status
fields.description: SyncStatus. Live state updated by the sync engine.

fields.name: mtime_cache
fields.description: Timestamp -> mtime map for warm-start skips.

fields.name: sync_state
fields.description: Forward/reverse sync state including residual_metrics counters.

schemas.example:
id: team/repo
status: synced
mtime_cache: {}
sync_state:
  last_sync: "2026-10-04T10:30:00Z"
  residual_metrics:
    forward: 0
    reverse: 0

schemas.name: epic frontmatter
schemas.description: Same field set as story frontmatter, but used on the epic overview file (README.md or index.md, case-insensitive). Serves as the epic-level context anchor; can carry supporting_docs regardless of type.
schemas.path: README.md or index.md in an epic directory

fields.name: type
fields.description: Document type for the epic overview. Non-actionable types (doc, retro) are common.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Optional epic-level status. Actionable types only.

fields.name: story_id
fields.description: Display label. Defaults to the epic directory name.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: Cross-epic dependencies. Same resolution rules as story frontmatter.

fields.name: supporting_docs
fields.description: Epic overviews can have supporting_docs regardless of type.

fields.name: source_repo
fields.description: Default source repository for stories in this epic.

schemas.example:
---
type: story
supporting_docs:
  - ./retro-sprint-1.md
  - ./research-architecture-options.md
source_repo: acme/api
---

# Epic Overview: Pipeline Viewer

High-level context for the pipeline viewer epic...

schemas.name: story frontmatter
schemas.description: YAML frontmatter at the top of any .md file in a pipeline epic directory. type defaults to story when absent; status defaults to none (file renders without a status spine).
schemas.path: any .md file in a pipeline epic directory

fields.name: type
fields.description: Document type. Unknown values normalize to doc.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Pipeline status. Actionable types only (story, bug, spike). Invalid values silently ignored.

fields.name: story_id
fields.description: Display label on the pipeline node. Falls back to the file's basename minus .md.

fields.name: depends_on
fields.description: Story IDs within the epic. Cross-epic refs: "other-epic/S-1". Unresolved refs silently dropped.

fields.name: supporting_docs
fields.description: Relative paths - same-directory only; must be non-story types. Actionable stories only.

fields.name: source_repo
fields.description: Source repository identifier. Observed by the org story resolver.

schemas.example:
---
type: story
status: in-progress
story_id: W-5
depends_on: [W-3, W-4]
supporting_docs:
  - ./spike-auth-tokens.md
  - ./bug-login-race.md
source_repo: acme/api
---

# User Auth Flow

schemas.name: bundle.json
schemas.description: Agent launch bundle. Pre-wired agent + startup config a user can one-click launch. Fields inferred from DashboardLaunchState; the full schema is not generated yet.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Bundle identifier. Kebab-case; unique within the team.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name shown in the launch picker.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: Default agent to launch. Must reference an existing agent.yaml id.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short description of what the bundle sets up.

fields.name: launch_params
fields.description: Pre-populated launch parameters merged into the picker form.
